name: a-stock-earnings-season
description: Reviews each A-share quarter by combining earnings forecasts and periodic reports, checks profit quality, and cross-checks whether strong results are already priced in through price action and valuation.

displayDescription.en: Reviews each A-share quarter by combining earnings forecasts with periodic reports: splits out single-quarter growth, non-recurring items and cash backing, then cross-checks price action and valuation to show whether strong results are already priced in.
displayDescription.zh: 合看A股业绩预告与季报，拆增速与利润含金量，再用K线和估值判断业绩是否已被股价提前定价

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这季业绩怎么样？挑出业绩最好、股价还没怎么反映的公司
defaultInitPrompt.en: How did this quarter go? Find the strongest results the stock price has not yet reflected

quickPrompts.zh: 业绩好的这几家，股价是不是已经提前涨完了？
